attempts.lesson: Pitch or tilt the gripper to orient the pen vertically before lowering it into the holder so it fits inside rather than landing horizontally across the rim.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
# green_pen was dropped on magenta_holder and is currently misdetected or resting on it
# Check visible objects to find where green_pen is or re-grasp it
pen_name = "green_pen" if "green_pen" in obs["objects"] else None

# If not directly in objects, let's see what is at the holder:
# In the current scene, "green_mug" seems to be the pen detected across the holder (footprint_long: 0.1379, footprint_short: 0.0183, height: 0.092)
# But grasp_candidates might work on "green_pen" or "green_mug"
target_name = "green_pen"
try_cands = grasp_candidates(target_name)
if not try_cands:
    target_name = "green_mug"
    try_cands = grasp_candidates(target_name)

c = try_cands[0]
grasp(c)

# We hold the pen horizontally across fingers.
# To make it stand upright: tilt the gripper 90 degrees so the pen's long axis points vertically (downwards into holder).
# Note: side vector of gripper is parallel to the pen's long axis.
# When approach=[0, 0, -1], side lies in xy plane.
# If approach becomes horizontal, e.g., approach=[0, 1, 0] or [1, 0, 0], side or approach can align the pen vertically.
# Specifically: fingers squeeze along finger_axis. side = approach x finger_axis.
# If finger_axis is horizontal, and approach is horizontal, side is vertical [0, 0, +/-1]!
# That means the pen (which lies along `side`) will be perfectly VERTICAL!

holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Move high above the table first
move_gripper(hx, hy - 0.1, table_z + 0.25, approach=[0, 0, -1])

# Orient gripper so finger_axis is along X [1, 0, 0], approach is along Y [0, 1, 0]
# Then side = approach x finger_axis = [0, 1, 0] x [1, 0, 0] = [0, 0, -1] (points downwards!)
# So the pen points vertically downwards!
move_gripper(hx, hy - 0.05, table_z + 0.22, approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0])

# Move right over the holder center and lower the pen into the holder
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + 0.16, approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0])

# Release pen inside holder
open_gripper()

# Retreat up and park
retreat(0.12)
go_home()
check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")
